verdict.rationale: Evidence shows LocalAI exposes OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs for clients to call INTO LocalAI (docs-1, docs-2, docs-16), and supports MCP for external tool/data servers (docs-4, docs-33) — but none of this shows LocalAI itself routing requests OUT to actual cloud AI providers (e.g., configuring an OpenAI or Anthropic API key as a backend) so a user could mix cloud and local models within one interface. No evidence of a cloud-provider backend/proxy configuration exists in the pack.
